summary: Algorhythm Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that on September 21, 2026 it and Continuation Capital, Inc. mutually terminated a July 21, 2026 settlement agreement covering $1,928,014 of acquired legacy liabilities, under which the Company had agreed to issue up to 5,000,000 shares in tranches until CCI recouped 120% of the claim. The termination halts further share issuance; roughly $1,418,649 remains outstanding and reverts to the original creditors. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium was disclosed; the Company also furnished an updated investor presentation under Item 7.01. Watch dilution relief versus renewed creditor claims and liquidity pressure.
